scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: Look at those black clouds over the sea! Kili, come inside — a big storm is coming!
scene.intro: Look at those black clouds over the sea! Kili, come inside! Last winter there was a terrible storm here: the lightning lit up the whole bay, the thunder shook the windows and the fog arrived so thick that Maya couldn't see the lighthouse from her door. There was ice on the path and, later, a small flood in the basement. What was the worst weather YOU remember?

data.script: Maya: Storm report, day one! The storm arrived at four o'clock. … Maya: First the wind blew so hard that our gate flew into the garden! … Maya: Then came the lightning — I counted fifteen flashes in one minute! … Maya: The thunder was so loud that Kili hid under my bed. … Maya: It rained all night, and this morning there was a small flood near the bridge. … Maya: Now the sun is shining again, and there's a double rainbow over the sea. Science is amazing!
